                    };
                    window.closeCalendar = function() {
                        $(".c-events__button").removeClass("show");
                        $("body").removeClass("calendar-open");
                        $(".c-events__calendar-overlay").removeClass("is-open");
                        $('.c-events__button').attr('aria-expanded', 'false');
                    };

                    // ADA-compliant tab init for mobile event tabs
                    var $tabsContainer = $('.c-events__calendar-overlay .s-events__tabs');
                    $tabsContainer.tabs({
                        create: function (event, ui) {
                            ui.tab.attr({ tabindex: '0' });
                        },
                        activate: function (event, ui) {
                            ui.oldTab.find('a').attr({ tabindex: '-1' });
                            ui.newTab.find('a').attr({ tabindex: '0' });
                            ui.oldPanel.attr('aria-hidden', 'true');
                            ui.newPanel.attr('aria-hidden', 'false');
                        }
                    });

                    var $tabLinks = $('.c-events__calendar-overlay .s-events__tabs-link');

                    $tabLinks.each(function (i) {
                        var $link = $(this);
                        var panelId = $link.attr('href').substring(1);
                        $link.removeAttr('role');
                        $link.attr({
                            id: 'mobile-events-tab-' + i,
                            'aria-controls': panelId,
                            tabindex: i === 0 ? '0' : '-1'
                        });
                    });

                    $tabLinks.on('keydown', function (e) {
                        var currentIndex = $tabLinks.index(this);
                        var newIndex = null;

                        if (['ArrowRight', 'ArrowDown'].includes(e.key)) {
                            newIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % $tabLinks.length;
                        } else if (['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowUp'].includes(e.key)) {
                            newIndex = (currentIndex - 1 + $tabLinks.length) % $tabLinks.length;
                        } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                            newIndex = 0;
                        } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                            newIndex = $tabLinks.length - 1;
                        } else if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            $(this).trigger('click');
                            return;
                        }

                        if (newIndex !== null) {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            $tabLinks.eq(newIndex).focus();
                        }
                    });

                        $litabs.attr('tabindex', '0');
                        $atabs.attr('tabindex', '-1');
                    }
                    setTabIndex();
                    var observer = new MutationObserver(function() {
                        setTabIndex();
                    });
                    var targetNode = document.querySelector('.c-events__calendar-overlay section.s-events');
                    if (targetNode) {
                        observer.observe(targetNode, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
                    }

                        $tabsContainer.tabs({ active: tab_index });
                    };

                        window.closeCalendar();

                });
